attributes.action: FORMALLY ATTACH THE PREFIX 'ROYAL' TO THE TOWN OF BRIXHAM
attributes.additional_details:
I contend that such an action as advocated would address a glaring anomaly in the recognition of an absolutely fundamental and iconic event in our national history and the development of democracy in both this and other countries.
The precedent for such recognition exists c.f. 'Royal Wooton Basset'. It is no more than 'appropriate' that a location which is central to our 'national story' receive due recognition. 
There also may well be concomitant tourism benefits for the area.
attributes.background: I want what I consider to be due recognition accorded to the town of Brixham in view of its central role in the 1688 Glorious Revolution. This would entail the official formal attachment of the prefix 'Royal' to the name of that town.

rejection.details: I'm afraid this is about the giving of a royal honour and not something the Government or Parliament is responsible for - we also don't deal with petitions which affect a locality (city, town or district) bur rather policy matters that are in effect across the country.
